policy.name: The Industrial and Investment Promotion Policy of Manipur, 2022 (IIPPM 2022)

zone_lookup: Policy refers to 'notified locations' (para 13.1) but no location list is annexed in the gazette text; not district-zoned. Central UNNATI zones: all Manipur districts Zone B (central-ne.json).

schemes.name: IIPPM 2022 Capital Investment Subsidy
schemes.notes: 30% of P&M investment, aggregate ceiling Rs 50 lakh, new units 'in the notified location'; existing units on substantial expansion (>25% of existing building+P&M after 01.04.2022, para 9.12). Sole proprietorships of ST/SC/women/PwD get additional 2.5% on FIXED capital, ceiling Rs 20/30/40 lakh for micro/small/medium (13.1(ii)). Single-instalment disbursal. Only MSMEs in THRUST AREAS (para 8.1 manufacturing: food processing/cold chain, bamboo, packaging, honey, floriculture & MFP, pharma & medical devices, textiles, handicrafts & pottery, green/renewable energy, aromatic & medicinal plants, waste-recycling/compostable plastics, NTFP processing, rubber/wood) commencing commercial production after notification and on/before 31.03.2027 (para 10.1, 10.5). Incentives Eligibility Certificate required (10.6). Benefit reduced by any central/NEC incentive received for the same purpose (para 10.8, 9.14) - interacts with UNNATI.
conditions: New unit in a location notified under the policy

schemes.name: IIPPM 2022 Reimbursement of certification registration/renewal fee
schemes.notes: Full reimbursement of registration/renewal fees for BIS/ISI, ISO, AGMARK, FPO, FSSAI, MPCO etc., ceiling Rs 50,000 PER ANNUM for 5 years. SC/ST/women/PwD sole proprietors: additional 10% of the amount exceeding the ceiling.

schemes.name: IIPPM 2022 Quality control testing equipment subsidy
schemes.notes: 30% of cost of testing equipment for quality control, max Rs 5 lakh.

other_benefits: Power subsidy: reimbursement of power charges for first 5 years from production at 50% (micro & small, 1-50 kW), 23.7% (medium, 25-125 kVA); per-annum ceiling column illegible/blank in gazette scan; only if no other power subsidy availed (para 13.11) - percentage-of-bill, not per-unit.
Power line drawal (20 kV+) reimbursement up to Rs 15 lakh; DG sets 30% up to Rs 20 lakh; mini solar plant for micro 50% up to Rs 40,000 (para 13.11).
Insurance premium: 100% on capital investment for 10 years 'as extended by Central Government' (13.1(iv)).
Transport subsidy (micro & small): 25% for raw material transport >50 km within State and air freight from Kolkata/NER airports, 5 years (13.1(vii)).
Patent/trademark registration fee: 70%/50%/30% (micro/small/medium) up to Rs 1 lakh (13.12).
Stamp duty & registration on loan documents: up to Rs 30,000/40,000/50,000 (micro/small/medium) (13.14).
EMD/security deposit exemption 50% for M&S (100% for SC/ST/women/PwD proprietors) (13.10); 10% price preference (13.17).

IIPPM 2022 Interest subsidy on working capital: working-capital interest subsidy (not a term loan). 3% on WORKING CAPITAL loan (not term loan) for 10 years after commercial production, new units in notified locations, and existing units on expansion; no cap stated. Only MSMEs in THRUST AREAS (para 8
